## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| action | string |  | No | Optional action button label.<br/>When provided, an action button is rendered. |
| closeButton | boolean | false | No | Whether to show the close (dismiss) icon button. |
| duration | number | 4000 | No | How long the snackbar stays visible (in ms) before auto‑dismissing.<br/>Use `SnackbarDuration.INDEFINITE` to disable auto‑dismiss. |
| multiLine | boolean | false | No | When `true`, the snackbar uses a taller multi‑line layout<br/>with action buttons aligned to the bottom‑end. |
| onAction | (() =&gt; void) |  | No | Callback fired when the action button is clicked. |
| onClose | (() =&gt; void) |  | No | Callback fired when the close button is clicked. |
| onDismiss | (() =&gt; void) |  | No | Callback fired when the snackbar is dismissed (by timeout, action, or close). |
| open | boolean | false | No | Whether the snackbar is visible.<br/>Controls the mount/unmount lifecycle. |
| supportingText | string |  | Yes | The supporting text displayed in the snackbar. |

## Slots
